capabilities: Sync vault files of any type through a self-hosted Rock Sync server
Record each change as a git commit so synced history is never lost
Merge concurrent edits on the server and resolve true conflicts in a dedicated view
Hold deletions from other devices until the user confirms them
Connect vaults and devices with per-device tokens and revocable one-time codes
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Most setup detail lives in separate documentation pages (deployment, security, storage, API) rather than the README itself; MCP access for Claude is off by default and handled by the server, not the plugin.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a hosted service, so users who want to sync through their own server, without accounts or third parties, have no first-party option.

relations.evidence: Claude can read and write the folders you choose, through MCP, if you turn it on.

requires.name: a self-hosted Rock Sync server (Docker Compose)

summary: Self-hosted sync plugin that keeps your vault on your own server, storing every change as a git commit with conflict-aware merges.
